TASK 04

Firebase IoT Monitoring Dashboard

Cloud-connected IoT monitoring and appliance control using ESP32 sensors, Firebase and a web dashboard.

01

Overview

The Smart Home dashboard is designed to monitor temperature, humidity and ambient light while also providing bulb control.

The documented hardware setup contains an ESP32, DHT11, LDR, relay and 230V AC bulb.

02

Concepts

Cloud Computing

Cloud services allow applications and devices to communicate through network-based infrastructure.

Firebase

Firebase is used as the cloud platform for the Smart Home system.

Authentication

Authentication is used to verify the identity of a user.

Realtime Database

The project documentation identifies Firebase Realtime Database as part of the system.

05

Wiring / Setup

The documented hardware architecture combines ESP32, DHT11, LDR and relay-controlled bulb hardware.

06

Implementation

The dashboard provides current-value cards for temperature, humidity, ambient light and bulb status.

The interface also provides appliance controls for turning the bulb ON or OFF.

07

Configuration

  • Temperature monitoring through DHT11.
  • Humidity monitoring through DHT11.
  • Ambient light monitoring through LDR.
  • Bulb control through relay.
  • Firebase Authentication and Realtime Database included in documentation.
08

Evidence

Firebase-based Smart Home dashboard evidence.
09

Challenges & Fixes

A cloud-connected IoT system requires coordination between hardware, network communication, database services and the web interface.

10

Reflection

This project connects embedded hardware with a web-based monitoring and control interface and provides practical exposure to cloud-based IoT architecture.
